newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau yr-on-yr inflation 4.9 pct Jan-Oct 1996.
newsitem.headline: Macau yr-on-yr inflation 4.9 pct Jan-Oct 1996.

text.p: Macau's year-on-year inflation, as measured by growth in the composite consumer price index, stood at 4.9 percent in the first 10 months of 1996, the Statistics and Census Department said on Friday.
Year-on-year inflation was four percent in October, and 5.4 percent in the 12-month period to Ocbober, it said.
The index grew 0.2 percent in October from September.

The latest figures showed inflation continued to ease. Year-on-year inflation stood at 5.5 percent in the first half and 5.8 percent in the first quarter of this year, after hitting 8.6 percent in full-year 1995.

The index averages the expenditure patterns of various income groups but excludes housing rents in Macau, a 21-square-kilometre territory administered by Portugal before China takes over in December 1999.
It had a population of 424,000 and per capita domestic product of US$17,000 at the end of last year.
